answer: We anchor agent identity in recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments to render spoofing computationally infeasible. A cryptographic pulse from a sequential verifiable delay function secures epoch transitions against precomputation. By enforcing high staking collateral coupled with automatic slashing penalties for double-signing, the expected utility of identity cloning becomes negative. This enforces a robust Nash equilibrium, reducing any adversarial identity attempt to an unexploitable relic.
